text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwait and Saudi Arabia have reservations on joining a Middle East bank for regional development including Israel. The two conservative Gulf Arab states have no ties with Israel.
- Kuwaiti-Korean trade committee meets on Saturday to discuss bilateral ties.
- Kuwait exported 5.8 million dinars worth of goods in September.
- Kuwait Airways to offer special discounts in hotels and car rental agencies for frequent-flyer club members.
- United Nations official in charge of eliminating Iraq's mass destruction arms Rolf Ekeus says Baghdad has biological weapons.
- Kuwait Finance Minsiter Rodhan says Egypt now ready to attract Arab and forign investment.
- United States confirms its commitment to Kuwait's security.
- Gulf Arab states plan to boost their defences. Defence ministers of the six-nation Gulf Cooperation Council ended on Wednesday two-days of talks in Riyadh.
